weapons.name: MCX Spear LT commercial .308 lightweight
weapons.source_note: Maker spec table lists the 16 in 7.62x51 barrel row as: "7.62x51 16 in [406.4 mm] Cold Hammer Forged Steel 1:10". States a 1:10 in twist = 254.0 mm for the .308/7.62x51 MCX-SPEAR. Note: SIG's MCX-SPEAR-LT line is catalogued in 5.56, 7.62x39 and .300 BLK; the 7.62x51 chambering is the MCX-SPEAR, so the .308 twist is taken from that maker row.

weapons.name: T3x Game .308 Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Sako Ltd manual, "Caliber / Rate of twist [in] / Number of grooves" table: "308 Win..........................11”. . 4". States 1 turn in 11 in (4 grooves) = 279.4 mm for T3x in .308 Win.

weapons.name: VSS Vintorez Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: "The twist rate is 1:210 mm (1:8.3 inches)." States a 1 turn in 210 mm twist for the VSS/Vintorez 9x39 barrel.

weapons.name: Model 627 8-shot stainless N-frame, 5" barrel, unfluted cylinder
weapons.source_note: NRA Shooting Illustrated states: "Smith & Wesson took a page out of its .38 Spl./.357 Mag. revolver book and rifled its 9 mm pistols with a 1:18.75-inch twist rate" and "the 1:18.75-inch twist rate of Smith & Wesson revolvers". Gives the S&W .38 Spl/.357 Mag revolver twist as 1 turn in 18.75 in = 476.25 mm. No S&W catalogue/manual publishing revolver twist was found.

weapons.name: Dvc semi-auto
weapons.source_note: NRA Shooting Sports USA: "The fully-ramped DVC Steel 9 mm and .38 Super barrels are a 1:16 right hand twist." States 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm for the STI DVC Steel 9 mm. STI is defunct; no archived STI catalogue was reachable (Internet Archive CDX/Wayback was offline at retrieval).

weapons.name: Staccato P semi-auto
weapons.source_note: NRA American Rifleman specification line: "Barrel: 4.4” Bull 1:16" twist." States the Staccato 2011 P 4.4 in bull barrel has a 1:16 in twist = 406.4 mm.

weapons.name: Staccato Xl semi-auto
weapons.source_note: NRA Shooting Sports USA: "The stainless-steel barrel is 5.4 inches with a 1:16-inch twist". States the Staccato XL barrel has a 1:16 in twist = 406.4 mm.
